evidenceBoundaries.noLivePollingClaim: qa-ui-driver.gd:148 disables periodic refresh; synthetic update_world tests updates, not a concurrent live polling race.
evidenceBoundaries.noWholeIterationAcceptance: BUILD2 targeted suite status is separate; this review does not settle whole ITER-0026.
